idea-plugin.name: Pika Control
idea-plugin.description:
Pika Control provides deterministic IntelliJ IDEA Run/Debug service control and changelist operations for the companion pika-idea-control Codex Skill.

  • List, start, stop, and restart exact Run Configurations.
  • Inspect executions and control duplicate instances safely.
  • List, create, organize, and delete IDEA changelists.

The plugin listens only on the local loopback interface. It does not use a cloud service and does not collect telemetry.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Initial JetBrains Marketplace release.

  • Loopback-only REST API for Run/Debug and changelist automation.
  • Exact execution identifiers and duplicate-instance protection.
  • Compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 through 2026.2.
